transcript.text: Y'all come meal prep with me as a gym girl who's trying to keep a snatched waist in effect.
So we're gonna start off with my money fruits, blueberries, and blackberries, and some egg whites.
What I love about this is that it's high in protein.
I add cottage cheese to get that extra base, and then from here you can add whatever ingredients you want.
I added turkey sausage, red peppers, onions, and spinach.
Moving on to the protein this week.
I'm doing chicken breast and salmon.
Season however you wish, and then moving on to the carbs this week.
I'm sticking with only sweet potato, because I'm limiting complex carbs.
For veggies, I'm going with a cucumber salad with dill and broccoli,
and there you have it, an easy high protein meal prep for the week.

myVersion.hook: Sunday prep with me, desi style, for fat loss without giving up roti.
myVersion.script:
Sunday prep with me, desi style, for fat loss without giving up roti.
Breakfast first. Moong dal soaked overnight, ground into a batter with ginger and green chilli. That's five mornings of chilla sorted.
Next, protein. Paneer cubes tossed in curd, haldi and tikka masala, straight into the air fryer.
And a tray of chicken tikka for the days I want something different.
Carbs. A small batch of brown rice, and I'll make rotis fresh. Yes, rotis stay.
Veggies. A big bowl of kachumber, and bhindi with onion, dry and crispy.
That's it. Five boxes, about two hours, Sunday done, and no more weekday excuses for ordering in.
